sourceTitle: On the Architectural History of Chester Cathedral
description: "On the Architectural History of Chester Cathedral" by Thomas Rickman is an analytical historical account written in the early 19th century. The book discusses the architectural features, styles, and the evolution of Chester Cathedral, aiming to elevate its significance among the notable ecclesiastical buildings of England.
